newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana bond commission OKs $164.1 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana bond commission OKs $164.1 mln in bonds.

text.p: The Louisiana Bond Commission gave final approval Thursday for nine debt issues totalling $164.1 million, including three deals by the Louisiana Public Facilities Authority.

The largest issue approved was $45 million of Louisiana Public Facilities Authority revenue and refunding bonds, for the Loyola University project, to refund the authority's 1994 bonds for various Loyola projects.

The commissison approved two other Facilities Authority issues -- $40 million for a capital equipment and lease purchase loan program, and $11 million for a loan-lease program for the state's General Health System through GE Capital Public Finance.
--$16 million City of Monroe sales tax increment revenue bonds for economic development projects.
--$15 million of Rapides Finance Authority mortgage revnue bonds to provide funds for low-interest loans for first time home buyers.
--$13.5 million New Orleans Aviation Board revenue bonds for a noise mitigation and land aquisition program.
--$12.5 million of East Baton Rouge Mortgage Finance Authority revenue refunding bonds, to provide funds for low-interest loans for first-time home buyers.
--$7.6 million Tammany Parish School Board, District 12, general obligation refunding bonds, to refund the board's 1990 series.
--$3.5 million of Ouachita Parish Industrial Development Board revenue bonds to expand and equip the EPCO Carbon Dioxide Products Inc facility in Sterlington.
